title: Implement FT-001 session lifecycle services
verify: Login creates a new LocalSession and does not revive expired or revoked sessions.
Session issuance uses the TASK-006 primitive: raw token returned once through transport, only SHA-256 token_hash persisted, and default expires_at is created_at plus 7 days.
Presented session tokens are verified by computing token_hash and using the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison path.
Logout revokes only the current session and invalid/missing logout can be idempotent.
Session validity is fail-closed from session, Account, and FarmMembership status.
Session services authenticate only active Account/FarmMembership records created by the separate admin/bootstrap boundary.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: session issuance evidence showing 7-day expires_at and token_hash-only persistence
session verification evidence showing malformed/unknown/revoked/expired tokens fail closed through token_hash lookup
evidence that session services do not create or activate Accounts/Memberships
constraints: Default session TTL is 7 days from created_at.
Do not silently revive expired or revoked sessions; login creates a new LocalSession.
Session services must consume the TASK-006 credential/session primitive and must not reimplement password hashing, token generation, token_hash derivation, or digest comparison with divergent rules.
Session services authenticate existing active identities and must not create or activate Account/FarmMembership records.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Missing, expired, revoked, malformed, or unknown session fails closed.
Disabled Account or disabled FarmMembership fails closed.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check session lifecycle tests prove created_at plus 7-day expires_at calculation, current-session-only logout revocation, and no revival of expired/revoked sessions.
Check session verification tests use token_hash lookup and the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison primitive for valid, malformed, unknown, revoked, and expired tokens.
Check session repositories/services use the Foundation Data Substrate session boundary and preserve the FT-001 session lifecycle.
purpose: Implement the FT-001 local password-session lifecycle for existing active Accounts and FarmMemberships.
success_outcome: Local credentials and sessions can be issued, validated, revoked, and fail-closed against Account and FarmMembership status.
anti_goals: No Account creation or bootstrap flow.
No hosted recovery or email delivery.

forbidden_scope: FT-003 Account creation or first-Boss bootstrap
stop_conditions: Session lifecycle cannot be proven fail-closed.
Session service reimplements or diverges from the TASK-006 credential/session primitive contract.
Implementation requires creating or activating Account/FarmMembership records inside session services.
Raw auth material would enter persistence, logs, or evidence.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
